per_run_differences.note: The V2 script adds gradient checkpointing, use_cache=False and a paged 8-bit optimizer so the 46-trajectory run fits the same 15GB T4 budget. This does not enter V1->E4 (E4 reuses the V1 adapter), but it means the E4->V2 contrast changes the training run and not only the training data. The v2 script comments note that max_seq_length is ignored in trl>=0.14; the trl version used for the v1 run was not recorded.

confound.label: PARTIALLY RESOLVED by E4; E4 itself confounded by evaluation-client change (found 2026-10-09)
confound.statement: E4 (V1 adapter + V2 parser = 18/23) holds the adapter fixed. Aggregate change V1->E4 = 0 tasks, with 4 task flips (2 recovered, 2 regressed). This is NOT a parser-only estimate: the reported E4 score was produced by a notebook-local evaluation loop (notebooks/colab_e4_session.ipynb cell 16) with different tool schemas, tool-call/result serialization, tool implementations and error semantics, no client-side re-parse, and a later run date (2026-09-16 vs 2026-09-01, live search/weather data). evaluation/run_eval_e4.py (client-matched) was not run. The remaining E4->V2 difference is +5 tasks, and that transition changes the adapter, the training data, and the V2 run's optimizer/gradient-checkpointing settings together.
confound.residual_confound: training/colab_train_7b_v2.py additionally enables gradient checkpointing, use_cache=False and a paged 8-bit optimizer; colab_train_7b.py does not. See training_config.per_run_differences.
